sceneTilemap-name.label: Name
sceneTilemap-name.tip: Tilemap Name (note: this is a label for user reference only)

sceneTilemap-layer.label: Layer
sceneTilemap-layer.tip:
Foreground layer always overlaps Background layer, Object layer always overlaps Background layer
If layers are the same type, sorting goes in order with the highest value displayed first
If the order is the same, sorting goes by Object list position

background.name: Background
background.tip: Background layer is always displayed behind (or 'under') Object layer and/or Foreground layer

foreground.name: Foreground
foreground.tip: Foreground layer is always displayed in front of (or 'on top of') Object layer and/or Background layer

object.name: Object
object.tip: Object layer is rendered in order by position and Prioritys set for tiles

anchor.name: Anchor Sampling
anchor.tip: Color is synthesized by sampling light relative to the Tilemap's anchor point

global.name: Global Sampling
global.tip: Color is synthesized by sampling multi-pixel locations relative to the Tilemap's location

ambient.name: Ambient Light
ambient.tip: Color is a composite of the current Scene's existing lighting

sceneTilemap-blend.label: Blend
sceneTilemap-blend.tip: Choose a formula to blend the color with the underlying color

sceneTilemap-anchorX.label: Anchor X
sceneTilemap-anchorX.tip: Horizontal position of rectangular area connection point between Tilemap and Scene

sceneTilemap-anchorY.label: Anchor Y
sceneTilemap-anchorY.tip: Vertical position of rectangular area connection point between Tilemap and Scene

sceneTilemap-parallaxFactorX.label: Parallax Factor X
sceneTilemap-parallaxFactorX.tip: Coefficient for horizontal tilemap movement when camera moves

sceneTilemap-parallaxFactorY.label: Parallax Factor Y
sceneTilemap-parallaxFactorY.tip: Coefficient for vertical tilemap movement when camera moves

sceneTilemap-conditions.label: Conditions
sceneTilemap-conditions.tip: Set a list of conditions for the Tilemap to be created; if they aren't met, the Tilemap isn't created

sceneTilemap-events.label: Events
sceneTilemap-events.tip:
$Tilemap Events
$Options
Autorun: Event triggers as soon as the Tilemap appears (including after reading save data)
Custom: triggered using the 'Call Event' command

sceneTilemap-scripts.label: Scripts
sceneTilemap-scripts.tip: Add Script files to extend Tilemap functions
